# Thermomechanical plate (example ex8 of mfem-mgis-examples: heat transfer
# with a Robin boundary condition, mechanics with swelling, iterative
# coupling), with its behaviours generated by the generic-parallel interface
# (libraries GenericParallelU3SI2 and GenericParallelALFENI of each
# backend). The executable is the one of mfem-mgis-examples, run in its
# build directory, the behaviour libraries being given by its options -lU
# and -lA; the mode of integration is given by the environment variables of
# mfem-mgis.
set(MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX8_DIR "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_BINARY_DIR}/ex8"
  CACHE PATH "build directory of the example ex8 of mfem-mgis-examples")
set(_mfront_directory "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_SOURCE_DIR}/ex8/MFront")
file(GLOB _sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${_mfront_directory}/*.mfront")
add_generic_parallel_mfront_libraries(ex8-behaviours CUDA ${_sources}
  LIBRARIES U3SI2 ALFENI
  INCLUDE_DIRECTORY "${_mfront_directory}")

# short tests: the coarse mesh of the example on two processes, all the
# computations by kernels, with the behaviours of each backend, the
# statistics of the fields being compared to the reference values of the
# example
proto_check_executable(_usable "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX8_DIR}/rjh_plate")
if(_usable)
  set(_run mpirun -n 2 ./rjh_plate -m assemblage_hexa_coarse.msh
           -lsMc MUMPSSolver -no-pp
           -rf assemblage_hexa_coarse-statistics.ref)
  set(_kernels "MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;MFEM_MGIS_GRADIENTS_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_INNER_FORCES_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_TANGENT_OPERATOR_COMPUTATION=Kernels")
  foreach(_backend ${ex8-behaviours_BACKENDS})
    set(_libraries
      -lU "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelU3SI2-${_backend}.so"
      -lA "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelALFENI-${_backend}.so")
    if(_backend STREQUAL "cuda")
      add_test(NAME ex8-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run} --device cuda ${_libraries}
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX8_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(ex8-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;${_kernels}"
        RESOURCE_LOCK gpu)
    else()
      add_test(NAME ex8-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run} ${_libraries}
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX8_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(ex8-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=2;${_kernels}")
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
